import 'typed_join.dart';
Future<void> main() async {
  var active = 0;
  var maximum = 0;
  final result = await mapWithConcurrency<int, int>([1, 2, 3, 4], 2, (item) async {
    active++;
    if (active > maximum) maximum = active;
    await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
    active--;
    return item * 2;
  });
  if (maximum != 2 || result.join(',') != '2,4,6,8') throw StateError('$maximum $result');
  print('maximum=$maximum results=$result');
}
